purpose: A routine check of your weight, blood pressure, and the baby's growth. Mention new symptoms. Seek prompt medical attention for severe headache, blurry vision, severe nausea or vomiting, right-sided upper abdominal pain, reduced urine, or sudden whole-body swelling.
what_to_bring: Weight, blood pressure and growth check. List any new symptoms. Seek prompt medical attention for severe headache, blurry vision, severe nausea or vomiting, right-sided upper abdominal pain, reduced urine or sudden swelling of the whole body.
questions: Is the baby's growth on track?
What should I watch for before the next visit?
